headline: Indian markets trade volatile as IT stocks drag benchmarks while steel prices hit four-year high

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex fell 330 points and Nifty ended below 23,350 driven down by IT stocks.
Steel prices reached a four-year high with the strong pricing trend expected to persist in H2.
Aviation Ministry confirmed DGCA is conducting operational and financial checks on SpiceJet.
Global market cues and crude price adjustments continue to create volatility across domestic benchmarks.
whatHappening: DGCA has initiated operational and financial audits on SpiceJet.
Steel prices surged to four-year highs according to industry reports.
India launched anti-dumping investigations against imports of Glycine chemical from China.
NSE's IPO received 6x subscription on its final day while 20 investment bankers earned ₹186 crore in fees.
summary: Indian equities experienced volatility as IT stock sell-offs dragged Sensex down 330 points and Nifty below 23,350. Steel stocks face tailwinds as steel prices hit four-year highs, while SpiceJet comes under pressure following DGCA operational and financial checks. Traders remain cautious amid mixed global cues and volatile crude oil trends.
